name: AmbientBadge
tagline: 为桌面通知角标加入玻璃质感与柔和光晕。
description: 微光角标为桌面通知角标加入玻璃质感与柔和光晕，提供胶囊和光环两种可切换样式。
两种样式共享位置与大小设置，可分别调整模糊底材强度，并支持应用配色或统一自定义颜色。
沿用系统原生角标数量，数量增加可触发柔和脉冲，关闭插件后恢复系统角标。
features: 胶囊与光环两种玻璃角标样式
自动跟随系统 Light / Dark 外观调整底材、文字和描边
使用 App 配色或统一自定义颜色
可调节外围环境光晕强度
胶囊与光环分别保存 0–100% Blur Opacity，不影响文字、描边和光晕
横向与纵向 −30～+30 pt 位置调节及一键归零
50%～150% 整体缩放，文字、符号和光晕同步调整
位置、大小与 Blur Opacity 支持滑块及手动数值输入
新通知或数量增加时可选单次柔和脉冲，并遵循系统“减弱动态效果”
保留 App 原有角标数量，大数量显示为 99+，关闭插件后恢复系统角标
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置，保存后即时应用
usage: 安装后打开“设置 → 微光角标”并开启插件。
选择胶囊或光环样式，并按需设置应用配色、自定义颜色和环境光晕强度。
分别调整两种样式的 Blur Opacity；位置与大小由两种样式共用。
拖动滑块后松手应用，或点击数值手动输入位置、大小和 Blur Opacity。
按需开启通知脉冲；所有设置保存后即时生效。

changes: 新增胶囊与光环两种玻璃角标样式，支持系统深浅外观、应用/自定义配色和环境光晕。
新增独立 Blur Opacity、位置、大小与手动数值输入，设置保存后即时生效。
新增通知脉冲、原生角标计数与 99+ 显示，并支持三语言设置和“减弱动态效果”。

en.name: AmbientBadge
en.tagline: Give notification badges a glass appearance and a soft ambient glow.
description: AmbientBadge gives Home Screen notification badges a glass appearance and a soft ambient glow, with selectable Capsule and Orbit styles.
Both styles share position and size controls, keep separate blurred-background intensity, and support app-based or unified custom colors.
It preserves native badge counts, can pulse gently when counts increase, and restores system badges when disabled.
features: Capsule and Orbit glass badge styles
Automatic material, text, and outline adaptation for system Light and Dark appearance
App-based colors or one unified custom color
Adjustable ambient glow intensity
Independent 0–100% Blur Opacity for Capsule and Orbit without fading text, outline, or glow
Horizontal and vertical position offsets from −30 to +30 pt with position reset
50%–150% overall scaling for badges, text, glyphs, and glow
Slider and manual numeric input for position, size, and Blur Opacity
Optional single pulse for new or increased badge counts, respecting Reduce Motion
Native badge counts with 99+ display and system-badge restoration when disabled
Settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese with immediate application
usage: Open Settings → AmbientBadge after installation and enable the tweak.
Choose Capsule or Orbit, then configure app colors, a custom color, and ambient glow intensity as desired.
Adjust each style's Blur Opacity independently; position and size are shared between styles.
Release sliders to apply changes, or tap values to enter position, size, and Blur Opacity manually.
Optionally enable notification pulses; saved settings apply immediately.

changes: Added Capsule and Orbit glass badge styles with system appearance adaptation, app or custom colors, and ambient glow.
Added independent Blur Opacity, position and size controls, and manual numeric input with immediate application.
Added notification pulses, native badge counts with 99+ display, trilingual settings, and Reduce Motion support.
